SUMMARY
AI Engineer (2026 B.Tech graduate) building agentic AI systems, MCP servers, and RAG pipelines in Python, integrated with existing systems through MCP and REST APIs. Hands-on with LangGraph, LangChain, vector search (Qdrant), LLM evaluation, and monitoring deployed AI applications.

LLMs / Agents: MCP, LangGraph, LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers, LiteLLM, QLoRA / PEFT

Deployment / Observability / Tools: Docker, Git, pytest, OpenTelemetry, Ollama, Antigravity

EXPERIENCE
Junior AI Engineer Intern – Mako IT Lab
March 2026 – Oct 2026 | Chennai
• Created a FastMCP converter turning OpenAPI/Swagger REST APIs into MCP servers that expose APIs as LLM tools; delivered authenticated MCP servers for Microsoft 365, Azure AI Foundry, and Cosmos DB.
• Architected a dual-agent LangGraph RAG pipeline for prospect enrichment (tested on 50+ prospects), with a 2-scope Mem0 conversational memory layer (session, user) persisting rep preferences.
• Designed a harness for a network-isolated microVM running a local 14B Qwen model: 24-step cap, forced stop after 2 consecutive errors, tool-allowlisting hooks (user confirmation for network and delete calls), secret redaction with audit logging, and pinned-prompt context trimming.
• Added security and governance controls: a LiteLLM pre-call hook enforcing per-key tool allowlists; disallowed tools are stripped or rejected with a 403 before upstream tokens are spent. Added a zero-retention audit ledger (SHA-256 prompt hashes) and Jaeger tracing.
• Instrumented 15 LangGraph nodes with OpenTelemetry for AI monitoring (tracing, metrics, structured logs), tracking node, LLM, and tool latency and per-call token usage via non-blocking Supabase writes.
• Built an LLM batch data pipeline on a LiteLLM Router (4 API keys), cutting per-prospect time from 7-8 to 5-6 min with zero rate-limit downtime across 40+ reports.
• Built a Parent-Child retrieval agent with 57-84% lower latency than GraphRAG across both pipelines; benchmarked 4 retrieval strategies (BGE embeddings; cross-encoder, BM25, RRF) on Precision@K, Recall@K, NDCG@K, Hit Rate@K; raised chatbot LLM-judged recall from 0.20 to 0.345 (+72.5%, 10 queries).
• Fine-tuned LLMs with QLoRA across 3 domains (sales QA, legal, biomedical) on datasets built from raw PDFs; Qwen3-4B on CUAD (5,000 samples) improved from F1 5.57 to 67.97 and Exact Match 0 to 67%.

Sep 2026
• Developed a confidence-gated support agent in LangGraph where an on-device model (Kev-0.8B) scores candidate actions and Pydantic validated YAML rules decide auto-execute, human review, or deny, with human approval and a matching guardrail in the refund tool for amounts above $50; added Qdrant policy retrieval, FastAPI + Gradio UI, Docker, CI (37 pytest tests), and live deployment on Render.
• Evaluated Kev-0.8B in strict no-fallback mode on a 100-ticket synthetic SaaS set: 91% accuracy, 2% option-order flip rate, ~163 ms P50 latency on Apple Silicon; reduced expected calibration error from 0.19 to 0.07 with temperature scaling fitted on a held-out split.
